WITH hand_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(p.bats, '') as bats_group,
    COUNT(*) as fielding_count
  FROM fielding f 
  LEFT JOIN player p ON f.player_id = p.player_id 
  GROUP BY COALESCE(p.bats, '')
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(fielding_count) as total_count,
    AVG(fielding_count) as avg_count
  FROM hand_counts
)
SELECT 
  hc.bats_group as batting_hand,
  hc.fielding_count as count,
  CAST(hc.fielding_count AS FLOAT) / s.total_count as share,
  hc.fielding_count - s.avg_count as above_average
FROM hand_counts hc
CROSS JOIN stats s
WHERE hc.fielding_count > s.avg_count
ORDER BY hc.fielding_count DESC
